heading_path: Part 17A—Protected international trade marks under the Madrid Protocol
Subdivision 3A—Cancellation or limitation of an international registration
text: If the International Bureau cancels an international registration in whole or in part the IRDA ceases, to the extent of the cancellation, when the international registration is cancelled.
title: Cancellation
